## JobCairn 0.2.0

A big update: smarter job search, recruiters, outreach that helps you stand out, and updates from inside the app.

### Updating from 0.1.x
Download the dmg below and drag it into Applications to replace the old version. Your workspace isn't affected. From 0.2.0 on, JobCairn updates itself: click the version number in the sidebar, then **Restart**.

### New
- **Updates inside the app.** JobCairn checks for new versions, downloads them in the background and installs on restart. You can turn automatic checks off.
- **Next-level job search.**
  - Describe the jobs you want in one box, such as "remote or hybrid data roles in Sydney, posted this week, no big tech". JobCairn turns it into filters you can see and change.
  - Filters go straight into LinkedIn, SEEK and Indeed searches, so results match better.
  - New date choices: this week, last 2 weeks or any number of days. Posted dates are now accurate, and the Jobs list can sort by newest posted.
  - One-click **Recent jobs**.
  - Find up to 200 jobs in one search. The default is 100.
  - If a search fails because of the internet or the browser, it tries again by itself.
  - **Repeat this search** every few hours or daily at a set time, with a notification about new jobs.
- **Recruiters.** A new screen for recruitment agencies: what they're hiring for, their published contact details and your notes. Track each one from To contact to Replied. Email a recruiter with your tailored resume, and ask about sponsorship if you need it. Every email waits for your OK.
- **Company contacts.** Company research also finds the careers page and the company's published contact emails.
- **Stand out from the pile.**
  - A keyword check shows which skills from the ad your resume is missing.
  - A **New · apply today** badge marks fresh ads.
  - Draft a short note to the hiring manager.
  - Follow-up reminders.
  - Thank-you drafts after interviews.
  - **People you know here**, from your LinkedIn connections export.
- **More help with decisions.**
  - Flags for stale and reposted ads.
  - Pay compared with similar ads you've saved.
  - **Add to Calendar** for interviews and follow-ups.
  - A side-by-side offer comparison with a drafted negotiation email.
- **Easier first run.** A **Set up JobCairn** checklist on Home walks you through Claude, Chrome, your profile, your first search and your first score.

### Improved
- Clicking **Score** in the Jobs list now scores the job in one click.
- Setting up Chrome's remote control opens the right Chrome page for you, with the address to copy if it doesn't.
- Installs are faster and say what went wrong when they fail, with the exact Terminal command to copy.
- The browser helper closes when a search ends, so it doesn't use memory in the background.
- Settings › Claude shows one way of paying at a time: your Claude plan, or an API key if you choose one. A saved API key is now used for runs.

### Download
- **Apple silicon (M1 or later):** `JobCairn-0.2.0-arm64.dmg`
- **Intel:** `JobCairn-0.2.0-x64.dmg`

Not sure which? Apple menu › About This Mac. **Chip** means Apple silicon; **Processor** means Intel.

Both are signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarised by Apple. The [install guide](https://jobcairn.github.io/install.html) has the full steps.

### Check your download
In the folder with the dmg and `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

    shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing

### Needs
macOS 13 (Ventura) or later, and a Claude plan that includes Claude Code.

Questions? Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/JobCairn/jobcairn/discussions), without personal details.

If JobCairn helps, please ⭐ star the repo. It helps others find it.
